name: Spark L2
short_description: Spark L2 funding-source integration for LNbits with wallet attribution, deposits, withdrawals, and admin audit tools
description: Integrates LNbits with an authenticated Spark L2 sidecar. Supports wallet-scoped Spark sends, one-time on-chain deposits, administrator-routed shared Spark receiving, fee-quoted on-chain withdrawals, idempotent reconciliation, and Recent Transfers auditing.
